text:
Maya Chen: Heads-up — all-hands starts in 10. Quick live check: stream + local recorder status? Slides pushed to the shared deck?
Lin (SRE): RecorderBot says local recording healthy, OBS crashed once earlier but auto-restarted on the fallback RTMP. We switched to the backup key.
Raj Patel: I pushed a tiny slide change ~5m ago (fix typo in roadmap slide). Link: https://drive/redwood/allhands-deck v2
Priya Gomez: Question for Chris during Q&A — can we clarify sequence for Dedicated vs Private rollout priorities? I'll queue it.
Maya Chen: @channel please keep mic background noise low, and post any urgent blocks here. If OBS goes down again use the "stream-fallback" runbook.
deploy-bot: Scheduled deploy to production in 2m; will be paused if CPU > 75% on inference-prod.
Lin (SRE): If OBS hangs, quick manual command to restart capture driver:
```
sudo systemctl restart obs.service
# wait 10s then check: journalctl -u obs.service -n 50 --no-pager
```
Raj Patel: Noted. Also we've got a small canary of the optimize feature in dedicated — Chris, do you want a one-slide mention or hold for product deep-dive?
Chris - CEO: Call it out briefly in the roadmap slide — say "Dedicated Optimize pilot (Q2)" and mention we'll share details in a follow-up AMA. Keep it high-level.
Priya Gomez: Thanks — I'll move one bullet up and add the Q2 tag.
Maya Chen: AV: remind presenters to use wired network if possible. Recorder-bot, will you upload recording to the usual folder and DM the team when done?
recorder-bot: Recording captured. Will upload to s3://redwood-recordings/all-hands/2790012345/ and post link when transfer complete.
Raj Patel: One more — for folks asking about latency benchmarks, putting a pointer in #docs after the call would help.
Maya Chen: Perfect. Any on-the-fly agenda swaps?
Lin (SRE): Minor timing slip — infra update might run 3m long. Recommend shifting Customer Q&A after leadership updates.
Maya Chen: OK shifting order: leadership -> infra (short) -> customer Q&A. Noted.
Priya Gomez: For leaders: someone from Product should be ready for the Dedicated pilot question, maybe @Raj?
Chris - CEO: I'll take the strategic bit, Raj you can handle technical ops follow-up.
Maya Chen: Great. See you all in the room. I'll post the final slide link in 2m. :thumbsup:
